whatsappMessage:
Hi Akshay Karate Academy Team,

I noticed your academy has exceptional 4.9★ ratings with 43 reviews opposite Atal Path in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new student admissions and batch inquiries.

Maine aapke karate academy ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial class booking, self-defense programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/akshaykarate

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Akshay Karate Academy Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Akshay Karate Academy) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial class booking and showcase of your self-defense training opposite Atal Path in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact classes, actual dojo photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
